scope: Reducir la conversion sincrona de la tira de 20 fotogramas en el renderer

method.clip: H.264 1920x1080 30 fps, 12 seconds, same clips as initial audit
method.profiles: Fresh isolated profile for each label; three fresh source paths per run plus cache and cancellation
method.instrumentation: Electron CDP Profiler and Performance metrics, requestAnimationFrame, wrapped native canvas/bitmap/reader APIs. Always-on-top visible window. No tests ran during profiling.
method.limitations: Other applications active. No OS cache reset. TaskDuration measures occupied renderer-main time, not CPU of all threads or GPU. No guarantee of input latency or installer behavior.
